verses.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.kjv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.web: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.kjv: The same was in the beginning with God.

verses.web: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.
verses.kjv: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

verses.web: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.kjv: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

verses.web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
verses.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

verses.web: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.kjv: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

verses.web: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.kjv: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

verses.web: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
verses.kjv: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

verses.web: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
verses.kjv: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

verses.web: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.kjv: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

verses.web: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
verses.kjv: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

verses.web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
verses.kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

verses.web: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.kjv: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

verses.web: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.kjv: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

verses.web: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
verses.kjv: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

verses.web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
verses.kjv: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

verses.web: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

verses.web: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
verses.kjv: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

verses.web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.kjv: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

verses.web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.kjv: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

verses.web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
verses.kjv: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

verses.web: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
verses.kjv: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

verses.web: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.kjv: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

verses.web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

verses.web: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
verses.kjv: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

verses.web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
verses.kjv: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

verses.web: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.kjv: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

verses.web: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
verses.kjv: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

verses.web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

verses.web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
verses.kjv: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

verses.web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.kjv: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

verses.web: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
verses.kjv: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

verses.web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.kjv: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

verses.web: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.kjv: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

verses.web: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.kjv: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

verses.web: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.kjv: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

verses.web: He said to them, “Come, and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.kjv: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

verses.web: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.web: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.kjv: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

verses.web: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

verses.web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.kjv: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

verses.web: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.kjv: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.kjv: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

verses.web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.kjv: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

verses.web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
verses.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

verses.web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.kjv: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

verses.web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
verses.kjv: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

verses.web: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

verses.web: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.
verses.kjv: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

verses.web: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.kjv: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

verses.web: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”
verses.kjv: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

verses.web: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”
verses.kjv: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

verses.web: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.
verses.kjv: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” They filled them up to the brim.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

verses.web: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

verses.web: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.kjv: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

verses.web: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”
verses.kjv: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

verses.web: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
verses.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

verses.web: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.
verses.kjv: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

verses.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

verses.web: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verses.kjv: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

verses.web: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables.
verses.kjv: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

verses.web: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
verses.kjv: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

verses.web: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
verses.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

verses.web: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”
verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

verses.web: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

verses.web: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
verses.kjv: But he spake of the temple of his body.

verses.web: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
verses.kjv: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

verses.web: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.
verses.kjv: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

verses.web: But Jesus didn’t trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,
verses.kjv: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

verses.web: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.kjv: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

verses.web: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.kjv: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

verses.web: The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.kjv: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see the Kingdom of God.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

verses.web: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”
verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into the Kingdom of God!
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.web: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.kjv: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.web: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
verses.kjv: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

verses.web: The windblows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.kjv: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

verses.web: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
verses.kjv: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

verses.web: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

verses.web: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verses.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

verses.web: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
verses.kjv: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

verses.web: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.kjv: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.web: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.web: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
verses.kjv: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

verses.web: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.
verses.kjv: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

verses.web: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.
verses.kjv: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.web: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
verses.kjv: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

verses.web: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
verses.kjv: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

verses.web: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.
verses.kjv: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

verses.web: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.
verses.kjv: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

verses.web: For John was not yet thrown into prison.
verses.kjv: For John was not yet cast into prison.

verses.web: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
verses.kjv: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Jews about purifying.

verses.web: They came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
verses.kjv: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

verses.web: John answered, “A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.
verses.kjv: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

verses.web: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
verses.kjv: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

verses.web: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.
verses.kjv: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

verses.web: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.web: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.kjv: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

verses.web: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
verses.kjv: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

verses.web: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.kjv: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

verses.web: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
verses.kjv: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

verses.web: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.kjv: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

verses.web: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
verses.kjv: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

verses.web: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

verses.web: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
verses.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

verses.web: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.
verses.kjv: He left Judea, and departed again into Galilee.

verses.web: He needed to pass through Samaria.
verses.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.

verses.web: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.
verses.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.web: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

verses.web: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

verses.web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

verses.web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

verses.web: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

verses.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?
verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

verses.web: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?”
verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

verses.web: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

verses.web: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
verses.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

verses.web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

verses.web: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
verses.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

verses.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

verses.web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
verses.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

verses.web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

verses.web: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
verses.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

verses.web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

verses.web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
verses.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

verses.web: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
verses.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

verses.web: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

verses.web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

verses.web: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

verses.web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

verses.web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
verses.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

verses.web: The disciples therefore said one to another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
verses.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

verses.web: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
verses.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

verses.web: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

verses.web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
verses.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

verses.web: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

verses.web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”
verses.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

verses.web: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
verses.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

verses.web: Many more believed because of his word.
verses.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;

verses.web: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
verses.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

verses.web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
verses.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

verses.web: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

verses.web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
verses.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

verses.web: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

verses.web: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

verses.web: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

verses.web: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
verses.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

verses.web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
verses.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

verses.web: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
verses.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

verses.web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judea into Galilee.

verses.web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
verses.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

verses.web: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
verses.kjv: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

verses.web: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.
verses.kjv: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

verses.web: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
verses.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

verses.web: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
verses.kjv: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

verses.web: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
verses.kjv: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

verses.web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
verses.kjv: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

verses.web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
verses.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

verses.web: He answered them, “He who made me well, the same said to me, ‘Take up your mat, and walk.’”
verses.kjv: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

verses.web: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat, and walk’?”
verses.kjv: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

verses.web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
verses.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

verses.web: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
verses.kjv: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

verses.web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.kjv: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

verses.web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
verses.kjv: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

verses.web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
verses.kjv: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

verses.web: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.kjv: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

verses.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
verses.kjv: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

verses.web: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.kjv: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

verses.web: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
verses.kjv: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

verses.web: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.kjv: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

verses.web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
verses.kjv: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

verses.web: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

verses.web: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

verses.web: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
verses.kjv: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

verses.web: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
verses.kjv: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

verses.web: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
verses.kjv: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

verses.web: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.kjv: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

verses.web: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
verses.kjv: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

verses.web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
verses.kjv: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

verses.web: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
verses.kjv: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

verses.web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verses.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

verses.web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
verses.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

verses.web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.kjv: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

verses.web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
verses.kjv: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

verses.web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
verses.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

verses.web: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
verses.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

verses.web: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
verses.kjv: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

verses.web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
verses.kjv: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

verses.web: I don’t receive glory from men.
verses.kjv: I receive not honour from men.

verses.web: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
verses.kjv: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

verses.web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.kjv: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

verses.web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

verses.web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
verses.kjv: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

verses.web: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
verses.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

verses.web: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
verses.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

verses.web: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.
verses.kjv: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

verses.web: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.
verses.kjv: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

verses.web: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.
verses.kjv: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

verses.web: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.kjv: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

verses.web: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”
verses.kjv: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

verses.web: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.kjv: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

verses.web: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.”
verses.kjv: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

verses.web: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.kjv: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, saith unto him,

verses.web: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
verses.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

verses.web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

verses.web: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

verses.web: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
verses.kjv: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

verses.web: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.
verses.kjv: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

verses.web: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
verses.kjv: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

verses.web: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

verses.web: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
verses.kjv: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

verses.web: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
verses.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

verses.web: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
verses.kjv: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

verses.web: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.
verses.kjv: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

verses.web: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
verses.kjv: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

verses.web: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
verses.kjv: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

verses.web: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

verses.web: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.kjv: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

verses.web: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
verses.kjv: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

verses.web: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.kjv: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

verses.web: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”
verses.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?
verses.kjv: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

verses.web: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”
verses.kjv: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

verses.web: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
verses.kjv: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

verses.web: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
verses.kjv: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

verses.web: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

verses.web: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
verses.kjv: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

verses.web: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
verses.kjv: And this is the Father’s will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

verses.web: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.kjv: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.web: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
verses.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

verses.web: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”
verses.kjv: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

verses.web: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

verses.web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
verses.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.web: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.
verses.kjv: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

verses.web: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.
verses.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

verses.web: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

verses.web: I am the bread of life.
verses.kjv: I am that bread of life.

verses.web: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.kjv: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

verses.web: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.
verses.kjv: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

verses.web: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.web: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.kjv: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

verses.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.kjv: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.web: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.kjv: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

verses.web: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
verses.kjv: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

verses.web: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.
verses.kjv: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

verses.web: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
verses.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

verses.web: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.kjv: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

verses.web: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
verses.kjv: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

verses.web: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
verses.kjv: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

verses.web: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
verses.kjv: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

verses.web: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
verses.kjv: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

verses.web: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
verses.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

verses.web: He said, “For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
verses.kjv: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

verses.web: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

verses.web: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

verses.web: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

verses.web: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
verses.kjv: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

verses.web: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.kjv: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

verses.web: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

verses.web: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.
verses.kjv: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

verses.web: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.
verses.kjv: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

verses.web: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”
verses.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

verses.web: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.
verses.kjv: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

verses.web: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
verses.kjv: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

verses.web: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
verses.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

verses.web: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.
verses.kjv: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

verses.web: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.
verses.kjv: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

verses.web: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
verses.kjv: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

verses.web: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”
verses.kjv: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

verses.web: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.
verses.kjv: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

verses.web: But when it was now the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verses.kjv: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

verses.web: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
verses.kjv: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

verses.web: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

verses.web: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.
verses.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

verses.web: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.kjv: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

verses.web: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”
verses.kjv: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

verses.web: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
verses.kjv: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

verses.web: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
verses.kjv: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

verses.web: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?
verses.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

verses.web: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
verses.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

verses.web: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?
verses.kjv: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

verses.web: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?
verses.kjv: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

verses.web: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
verses.kjv: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

verses.web: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.
verses.kjv: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

verses.web: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”
verses.kjv: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

verses.web: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

verses.web: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
verses.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

verses.web: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
verses.kjv: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

verses.web: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

verses.web: You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come.”
verses.kjv: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

verses.web: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

verses.web: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come’?”
verses.kjv: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

verses.web: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
verses.kjv: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

verses.web: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
verses.kjv: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

verses.web: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.
verses.kjv: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

verses.web: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
verses.kjv: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

verses.web: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?
verses.kjv: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

verses.web: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
verses.kjv: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

verses.web: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.
verses.kjv: So there was a division among the people because of him.

verses.web: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.kjv: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

verses.web: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
verses.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

verses.web: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
verses.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

verses.web: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
verses.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

verses.web: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?
verses.kjv: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

verses.web: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is accursed.”
verses.kjv: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

verses.web: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
verses.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

verses.web: “Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
verses.kjv: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

verses.web: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”
verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

verses.web: Everyone went to his own house,
verses.kjv: And every man went unto his own house.

verses.web: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
verses.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

verses.web: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.
verses.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

verses.web: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,
verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

verses.web: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
verses.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

verses.web: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
