verses.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

verses.web: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.
verses.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

verses.web: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
verses.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

verses.web: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
verses.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

verses.web: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
verses.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

verses.web: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
verses.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

verses.web: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
verses.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

verses.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world.He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.web: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

verses.web: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
verses.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

verses.web: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
verses.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

verses.web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
verses.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.web: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
verses.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

verses.web: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

verses.web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, that he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

verses.web: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.web: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I amhe, you will die in your sins.”
verses.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

verses.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

verses.web: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
verses.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

verses.web: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
verses.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

verses.web: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
verses.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

verses.web: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
verses.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

verses.web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

verses.web: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
verses.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

verses.web: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
verses.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

verses.web: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

verses.web: I know that you are Abraham’s seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
verses.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

verses.web: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
verses.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

verses.web: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

verses.web: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
verses.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

verses.web: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
verses.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

verses.web: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

verses.web: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
verses.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

verses.web: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.
verses.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

verses.web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
verses.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

verses.web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

verses.web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
verses.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

verses.web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
verses.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

verses.web: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
verses.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

verses.web: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

verses.web: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

verses.web: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
verses.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

verses.web: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
verses.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

verses.web: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”
verses.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

verses.web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

verses.web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through their midst, and so passed by.
verses.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

verses.web: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.kjv: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

verses.web: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
verses.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

verses.web: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

verses.web: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
verses.kjv: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

verses.web: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
verses.kjv: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

verses.web: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
verses.kjv: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

verses.web: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
verses.kjv: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

verses.web: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
verses.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

verses.web: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
verses.kjv: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

verses.web: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
verses.kjv: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

verses.web: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

verses.web: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
verses.kjv: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

verses.web: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.kjv: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

verses.web: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
verses.kjv: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

verses.web: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” There was division among them.
verses.kjv: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

verses.web: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
verses.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

verses.web: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
verses.kjv: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

verses.web: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
verses.kjv: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

verses.web: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.kjv: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

verses.web: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
verses.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

verses.web: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.kjv: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

verses.web: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
verses.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

verses.web: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
verses.kjv: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

verses.web: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
verses.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

verses.web: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
verses.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

verses.web: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
verses.kjv: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

verses.web: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.kjv: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

verses.web: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
verses.kjv: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

verses.web: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
verses.kjv: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

verses.web: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
verses.kjv: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

verses.web: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
verses.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

verses.web: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
verses.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

verses.web: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” They threw him out.
verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

verses.web: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
verses.kjv: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

verses.web: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
verses.kjv: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

verses.web: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
verses.kjv: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

verses.web: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
verses.kjv: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

verses.web: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
verses.kjv: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
verses.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

verses.web: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

verses.web: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.kjv: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.web: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
verses.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

verses.web: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

verses.web: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”
verses.kjv: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

verses.web: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.
verses.kjv: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.web: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.
verses.kjv: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

verses.web: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
verses.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

verses.web: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
verses.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

verses.web: I am the good shepherd.The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

verses.web: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.
verses.kjv: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

verses.web: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.
verses.kjv: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

verses.web: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;
verses.kjv: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

verses.web: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.kjv: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

verses.web: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold.I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.
verses.kjv: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

verses.web: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.kjv: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

verses.web: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”
verses.kjv: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

verses.web: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

verses.web: Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
verses.kjv: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

verses.web: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”
verses.kjv: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

verses.web: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

verses.web: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
verses.kjv: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

verses.web: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
verses.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

verses.web: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
verses.kjv: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

verses.web: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
verses.kjv: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

verses.web: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
verses.kjv: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

verses.web: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

verses.web: I and the Father are one.”
verses.kjv: I and my Father are one.

verses.web: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.kjv: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

verses.web: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

verses.web: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),
verses.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

verses.web: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’
verses.kjv: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

verses.web: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.
verses.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

verses.web: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
verses.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

verses.web: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
verses.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

verses.web: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.
verses.kjv: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

verses.web: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
verses.kjv: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

verses.web: Many believed in him there.
verses.kjv: And many believed on him there.

verses.web: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.
verses.kjv: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.web: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.
verses.kjv: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

verses.web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
verses.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

verses.web: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
verses.kjv: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

verses.web: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.web: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
verses.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

verses.web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
verses.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judea again.

verses.web: The disciples told him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?”
verses.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

verses.web: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
verses.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

verses.web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
verses.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

verses.web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
verses.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

verses.web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
verses.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

verses.web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

verses.web: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
verses.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

verses.web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”
verses.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

verses.web: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
verses.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

verses.web: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
verses.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

verses.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
verses.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

verses.web: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
verses.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

verses.web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
verses.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

verses.web: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
verses.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

verses.web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
verses.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
verses.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

verses.web: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
verses.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

verses.web: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
verses.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

verses.web: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here, and is calling you.”
verses.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

verses.web: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.
verses.kjv: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

verses.web: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
verses.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

verses.web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
verses.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

verses.web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
verses.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

verses.web: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

verses.web: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
verses.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

verses.web: Jesus wept.
verses.kjv: Jesus wept.

verses.web: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

verses.web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
verses.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

verses.web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

verses.web: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
verses.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

verses.web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
verses.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

verses.web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude that stands around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
verses.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

verses.web: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
verses.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

verses.web: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
verses.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

verses.web: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.
verses.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

verses.web: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.
verses.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

verses.web: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
verses.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

verses.web: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
verses.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

verses.web: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
verses.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

verses.web: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
verses.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

verses.web: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
verses.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

verses.web: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

verses.web: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
verses.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

verses.web: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

verses.web: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
verses.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

verses.web: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
verses.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

verses.web: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
verses.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

verses.web: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

verses.web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
verses.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

verses.web: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

verses.web: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
verses.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,

verses.web: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
verses.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

verses.web: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
verses.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

verses.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

verses.web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
verses.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

verses.web: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.web: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
verses.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

verses.web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
verses.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

verses.web: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.web: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
verses.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.web: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
verses.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

verses.web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
verses.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

verses.web: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
verses.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

verses.web: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.
verses.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

verses.web: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
verses.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

verses.web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
verses.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

verses.web: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.
verses.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

verses.web: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
verses.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

verses.web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
verses.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

verses.web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

verses.web: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

verses.web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
verses.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

verses.web: Father, glorify your name!” Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
verses.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

verses.web: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

verses.web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

verses.web: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
verses.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

verses.web: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
verses.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

verses.web: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

verses.web: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”
verses.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

verses.web: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

verses.web: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
verses.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

verses.web: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
verses.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

verses.web: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
verses.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

verses.web: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
verses.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.web: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
verses.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

verses.web: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
verses.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

verses.web: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
verses.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

verses.web: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
verses.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

verses.web: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

verses.web: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
verses.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

verses.web: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

verses.web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
verses.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

verses.web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

verses.web: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
verses.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

verses.web: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.web: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;

verses.web: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
verses.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

verses.web: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

verses.web: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

verses.web: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

verses.web: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
verses.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

verses.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

verses.web: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

verses.web: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

verses.web: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
verses.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

verses.web: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.web: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
verses.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

verses.web: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

verses.web: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
verses.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.web: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
verses.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

verses.web: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.web: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
verses.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

verses.web: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.
verses.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

verses.web: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

verses.web: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

verses.web: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.web: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
verses.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

verses.web: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

verses.web: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

verses.web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
verses.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

verses.web: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
verses.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

verses.web: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
verses.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

verses.web: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
verses.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

verses.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just like I have loved you; that you also love one another.
verses.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

verses.web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

verses.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
verses.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

verses.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

verses.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
verses.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

verses.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

verses.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
verses.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

verses.web: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
verses.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

verses.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
verses.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

verses.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
verses.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

verses.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
verses.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

verses.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
verses.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

verses.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

verses.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

verses.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

verses.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—
verses.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

verses.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
verses.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

verses.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
verses.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

verses.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

verses.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

verses.web: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
verses.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

verses.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
verses.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

verses.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

verses.web: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

verses.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
verses.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

verses.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verses.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

verses.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
verses.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

verses.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
verses.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

verses.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
verses.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

verses.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
verses.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

verses.web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
verses.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

verses.web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

verses.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

verses.web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

verses.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

verses.web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

verses.web: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

verses.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
verses.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

verses.web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
verses.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

verses.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

verses.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
verses.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

verses.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
verses.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

verses.web: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
verses.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

verses.web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
verses.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

verses.web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

verses.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
verses.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

verses.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

verses.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
