verses.web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
verses.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

verses.web: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
verses.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

verses.web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

verses.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
verses.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

verses.web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
verses.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

verses.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.kjv: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

verses.web: “When the Counselorhas come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
verses.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

verses.web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

verses.web: “These things have I spoken to you, so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

verses.web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
verses.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

verses.web: They will do these thingsbecause they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

verses.web: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

verses.web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

verses.web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

verses.web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

verses.web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
verses.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

verses.web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
verses.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

verses.web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
verses.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

verses.web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
verses.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

verses.web: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verses.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

verses.web: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
verses.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

verses.web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
verses.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.web: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takesof mine, and will declare it to you.
verses.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.web: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

verses.web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
verses.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

verses.web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
verses.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

verses.web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
verses.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

verses.web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
verses.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

verses.web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

verses.web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
verses.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

verses.web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
verses.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

verses.web: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

verses.web: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
verses.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

verses.web: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

verses.web: I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
verses.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

verses.web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.
verses.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

verses.web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

verses.web: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

verses.web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verses.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

verses.web: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;
verses.kjv: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

verses.web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

verses.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

verses.web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
verses.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

verses.web: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.
verses.kjv: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

verses.web: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.
verses.kjv: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

verses.web: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
verses.kjv: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

verses.web: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.
verses.kjv: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

verses.web: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
verses.kjv: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

verses.web: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.kjv: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

verses.web: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
verses.kjv: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

verses.web: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.web: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
verses.kjv: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

verses.web: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.kjv: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

verses.web: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
verses.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

verses.web: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.
verses.kjv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

verses.web: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
verses.kjv: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

verses.web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
verses.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

verses.web: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
verses.kjv: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

verses.web: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,
verses.kjv: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

verses.web: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
verses.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

verses.web: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;
verses.kjv: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

verses.web: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.
verses.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

verses.web: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
verses.kjv: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

verses.web: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
verses.kjv: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

verses.web: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
verses.kjv: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

verses.web: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
verses.kjv: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

verses.web: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.kjv: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

verses.web: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
verses.kjv: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

verses.web: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out, and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

verses.web: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.kjv: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

verses.web: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

verses.web: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.kjv: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

verses.web: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

verses.web: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”
verses.kjv: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

verses.web: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

verses.web: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,
verses.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

verses.web: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.kjv: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

verses.web: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
verses.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

verses.web: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;
verses.kjv: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

verses.web: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.kjv: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

verses.web: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
verses.kjv: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man’s disciples? He saith, I am not.

verses.web: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.kjv: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

verses.web: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.
verses.kjv: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

verses.web: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.”
verses.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

verses.web: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

verses.web: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.
verses.kjv: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.web: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it, and said, “I am not.”
verses.kjv: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

verses.web: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
verses.kjv: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

verses.web: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
verses.kjv: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

verses.web: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.kjv: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

verses.web: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
verses.kjv: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

verses.web: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”
verses.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

verses.web: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,”
verses.kjv: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

verses.web: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.kjv: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

verses.web: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
verses.kjv: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

verses.web: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”
verses.kjv: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

verses.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
verses.kjv: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

verses.web: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
verses.kjv: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

verses.web: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
verses.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

verses.web: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.kjv: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

verses.web: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.
verses.kjv: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

verses.web: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
verses.kjv: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

verses.web: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
verses.kjv: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

verses.web: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.kjv: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

verses.web: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
verses.kjv: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

verses.web: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
verses.kjv: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

verses.web: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”
verses.kjv: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

verses.web: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

verses.web: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.
verses.kjv: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

verses.web: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?”
verses.kjv: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

verses.web: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

verses.web: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
verses.kjv: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cesar’s friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cesar.

verses.web: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
verses.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

verses.web: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
verses.kjv: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

verses.web: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”
verses.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.

verses.web: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
verses.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

verses.web: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
verses.kjv: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

verses.web: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
verses.kjv: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

verses.web: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.kjv: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.web: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.kjv: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

verses.web: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, I am King of the Jews.’”
verses.kjv: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

verses.web: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
verses.kjv: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

verses.web: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.kjv: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

verses.web: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.
verses.kjv: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

verses.web: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.kjv: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.web: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold your son!”
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

verses.web: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.kjv: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

verses.web: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty.”
verses.kjv: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

verses.web: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
verses.kjv: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

verses.web: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

verses.web: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.kjv: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

verses.web: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;
verses.kjv: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

verses.web: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
verses.kjv: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

verses.web: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
verses.kjv: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

verses.web: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
verses.kjv: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

verses.web: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”
verses.kjv: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

verses.web: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
verses.kjv: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

verses.web: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.
verses.kjv: And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

verses.web: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
verses.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

verses.web: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
verses.kjv: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

verses.web: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
verses.kjv: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

verses.web: Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.
verses.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

verses.web: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.
verses.kjv: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

verses.web: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”
verses.kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

verses.web: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.kjv: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

verses.web: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.
verses.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

verses.web: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn’t enter in.
verses.kjv: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

verses.web: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,
verses.kjv: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

verses.web: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.kjv: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

verses.web: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
verses.kjv: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

verses.web: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.kjv: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

verses.web: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.
verses.kjv: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

verses.web: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
verses.kjv: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

verses.web: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
verses.kjv: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

verses.web: They told her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”
verses.kjv: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

verses.web: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.kjv: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

verses.web: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.
verses.kjv: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

verses.web: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.kjv: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

verses.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.kjv: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

verses.web: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
verses.kjv: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

verses.web: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”
verses.kjv: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

verses.web: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
verses.kjv: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

verses.web: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
verses.kjv: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

verses.web: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the midst, and said, “Peace be to you.”
verses.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

verses.web: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
verses.kjv: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

verses.web: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
verses.kjv: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me,you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

verses.web: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.kjv: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

verses.web: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
verses.kjv: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

verses.web: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.
verses.kjv: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

verses.web: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.kjv: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

verses.web: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.
verses.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

verses.web: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
verses.kjv: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

verses.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.kjv: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

verses.web: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

verses.web: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.
verses.kjv: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

verses.web: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.
verses.kjv: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

verses.web: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.
verses.kjv: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

verses.web: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
verses.kjv: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast.” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

verses.web: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
verses.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

verses.web: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.
verses.kjv: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

verses.web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.kjv: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

verses.web: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.kjv: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

verses.web: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.kjv: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.”
verses.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

verses.web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

verses.web: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ breast at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
verses.kjv: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

verses.web: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.kjv: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

verses.web: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.kjv: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

verses.web: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.
verses.kjv: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

verses.web: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
verses.kjv: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
